profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Skyward
profile.summary:
As a recent Computer Science graduate from Marquette University with hands-on experience in both front-end and back-end development, I’m passionate about creating scalable, user-friendly software solutions.

During my Software Engineer Internship at Direct Supply, I contributed to multiple impactful projects, including developing features for web applications using React, JavaScript, and PostgreSQL, and automating RabbitMQ processes with Python and AWS DynamoDB. These experiences refined my skills in writing clean, maintainable code and collaborating within agile teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

I thrive at the intersection of technical problem-solving and user experience design, aiming to build tools that make technology more intuitive and accessible. Whether working on data-rich applications or optimizing system performance, I bring a commitment to innovation, adaptability, and continuous learning.

I’m currently seeking entry-level software engineering opportunities where I can contribute my skills and grow alongside a dynamic team. Let’s connect if you’re looking for a driven and collaborative engineer with a solid foundation in web development and a passion for creating impactful software.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented a comprehensive spreadsheet to analyze daily sales data and calculate average purchases of bakery items, enabling the manager to make informed ordering decisions and optimize inventory levels

• Worked closely with other baristas to improve existing new hire process to better streamline process of training and ensure alignment across all cafe staff regarding job expectations and duties, leading to improved operational consistency and customer satisfaction.  

• Proposed and implemented enhancements to the register area, including the introduction of a concise list featuring baristas' favorite drinks and a clear display of cup sizes, resulting in improved customer decision-making and decreased wait times at the register.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Customer Service · Coffee · Barista

positions.title: Chromebook Deployment Technician
positions.description:
- Assisted in the setup, configuration, and deployment of Chromebook devices, ensuring proper functioning for users.
- Gained hands-on experience with Chrome OS, learning its architecture and setup process, contributing to troubleshooting and system updates.
- Developed a strong attention to detail by meticulously following deployment protocols, reducing errors during device setup.
- Applied basic problem-solving skills to resolve technical issues during the configuration and deployment phases.
- Demonstrated organizational skills by maintaining documentation of deployment progress and managing inventory of devices.
- Collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams and end-users to ensure smooth deployment and user satisfaction.
- Fostered a passion for technology and continuous learning, gaining exposure to the IT field and device management.
positions.insights: Skills: System Deployment · Troubleshooting · Attention to Detail · Strategic Collaboration · Organization Skills

positions.title: Educational Opportunity Program Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored and mentored six first-generation and first-year college students in challenging courses, including Software Engineering, Object-Oriented Design, and Data Structures.

• Collaborated with students to identify opportunities to integrate technology and computational thinking into their respective academic disciplines, fostering innovative approaches to problem-solving.

• Coached students on effective communication strategies with professors and peers, fostering strong academic relationships and expanding their professional networks.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented an automation program using Python to address transient RabbitMQ errors, running every 10 minutes. This initiative significantly reduced manual intervention, improved system reliability, and minimized downtime and operational disruptions.

• Enhanced a pre-existing Yeoman Generator to facilitate the creation of personalized Terraform modules and an appropriate GitLab YAML script. These contributions significantly accelerated development speed, ensured consistency, reduced manual effort, and facilitated smoother deployment processes.

• Played a key role in developing new features for a web application using NodeJS on the front-end, C# on the API, and PostgreSQL on the backend. 

• Implemented user-requested features and addressed bugs and issues, ensuring a seamless user experience and high customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Communication · HTML · Terraform · Node.js · Web Development · Gitlab · Agile Methodologies · Python (Programming Language) · C# · PostgreSQL · C++ · React.js

positions.title: Audio Visual Technician
positions.description:
• Collaborated with clients through email and in-person communication to understand event requirements

• Implemented rigorous testing procedures for audio-visual equipment prior to events, reducing the occurrence of technical failures during events

• Proactively identified and resolved technical issues related to audio-visual equipment during events, ensuring uninterrupted functionality and a seamless experience for attendees.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Technical Production · Audio Equipment

positions.title: STEM Program Coordinator
positions.description:
• Created and implemented 12 weeklong lesson plan introducing middle school students to Python programming, fostering their interest in
technology and computer science.
• Collaborated with fellow educators and club staff to identify and address challenges in delivering STEM education, contributing to the
continuous improvement of educational programs.
positions.insights: Skills: Lesson Planning · Python (Programming Language) · Video Editing · Video Production

projects.title: TrackMyApps
projects.description: I am currently developing an automated solution to streamline the job application process. Using Python and the Gmail API, I am currently building a program that autonomously scans my personal Gmail account for relevant job-related emails. The program extracts key details and updates a Google Sheet in real time, allowing me to effortlessly track the status of my applications, interview progress, and communication history. This system is intended to significantly reduce manual tracking, ensuring that I never miss an important update while maintaining an organized view of my job search.
